verdict.rationale: Pylon's own Assist Agent can be messaged to investigate issues, draft replies and perform actions. Ask AI answers natural-language questions about workspace data, and the Slack Agent takes quick actions from Slack, so users can operate the product conversationally. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions natural-language commands can execute and any limits on them, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote:
Message the Assist Agent to:

* Investigate issues more deeply
* Draft replies
* Perform actions
Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
Ask AI is a general purpose AI chat that can help you and your team answers all the questions you might have about your existing data.
Answer product and customer questions and take action directly from Slack.
